insights.one_liner: Amsterdam-headquartered trading firm and market maker; IND sponsor, English-only roles, non-hierarchical culture with profit sharing.

culture.text: Describes a non-hierarchical, close-knit 'small-company feel' with Flow Academy training, discretionary profit share and rewards for team contributions.
Staff often studied computer science, economics, finance or maths at UvA, VU, Erasmus or TU Delft.
Mid-sized: more than 600 employees in 10 locations, 956 people on LinkedIn.

open.text: Flow Traders B.V. and Flow Traders Amsterdam Services B.V. are IND recognised visa sponsors.

growth.text: An update reported significantly lower trading revenue.

worth_knowing.text: Chose CoreWeave to support its AI and deep-learning model training.
